title: Projected US inheritance by generation, through 2048

source.name: US Advisor Metrics: The Cerulli Report -- The Great Wealth Transfer

notes: Cerulli's generation-by-generation projection of the $105 trillion flowing to heirs through 2048: Millennials $46T, Gen X $39T, Gen Z $15T. These three generations account for $100T of the $105T total to heirs; the remainder goes to the Silent Generation and other/unspecified heirs.
